title: Definition and Measurable Indicators for "Good Jobs" under Economic Strategy Review
what_it_is: Definition and Measurable Indicators for "Good Jobs" under Economic Strategy Review

sections.label: Labour market indicators and outcomes
sections.summary: Singapore measures labour market participation, underutilisation and earnings, and reports income growth, less discrimination and low fatality rates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The perception of what constitutes good jobs also has a time dimension to it and may change with age.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Hence, we chose to measure a range of more objectively measurable labour market indicators and regularly benchmark our labour market performance internationally across key dimensions that cover job creation and job quality, such as: one, labour market participation; two, labour underutilisation; and three, earnings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These are broadly aligned with the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) framework and across these domains, Singapore generally ranks favourably relative to OECD economies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From 2021 to 2025, real gross monthly income at the median grew by 7.4%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: At the 20th percentile, income grew even faster, by 10.1% over the same period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Fewer employees experienced discrimination at work, with the proportion decreasing from 8.5% in 2021, to 6% in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Our Workplace Safety and Health performance also ranked amongst the top performing countries, with a five-year average workplace fatality rate of 1.1 per 100,000 workers in 2024.

sections.label: Definition of well-paying jobs
sections.summary: Well-paying jobs are those that pay above the median wage of the resident workforce.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In general, well-paying jobs are those that pay above the median wage of the resident workforce.

sections.label: International job quality frameworks
sections.summary: Relevant dimensions from other international job quality frameworks, including the OECD's, will be considered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In doing so, we will consider relevant dimensions that are included in other international frameworks of job quality, including the one that the Member has mentioned – the OECD's job quality framework.
